column1: # What run-agent prices a run with: USD per million tokens, first-party API
# list prices. Tab-separated: model, input, output, cache read, cache write.
# Cache writes are priced at the 5-minute rate (1.25x input). Claude Code does
# not report which TTL it wrote, so a run that wrote 1-hour entries is priced
# low by the difference. Haiku 5.5 is priced at its rate for prompts up to 100K
# Every model pick.sh can choose has a row; test.sh fails otherwise. Older ids
# stay, so a pinned or caller-chosen model is still priced. A model with no row
# falls back to the cost claude-code-action reported, and run-agent warns.
